purpose: Prevent the early corpus from drifting into the highest-risk deaths before consent, review, and public-safety procedures exist.

minimum_requirements: specialist pediatric palliative or bereavement review
guardian/family consent where any private account is involved
no child’s words published without exceptional review
rev0019_minimum_additions: suicide-safe review for adolescent self-harm records
public-health/forensic review for SUID and child-death-review records

minimum_requirements: ability to refuse, restrict, revise, or remove
no interior details taken from outsiders
avoid operational details that could harm

high_gate_domains.name: absence_unclaimed_unidentified_or_missing_body
minimum_requirements: no public names or case details
do not treat official records as total truth
do not treat unclaimed status as lack of love
respect ritual/cultural delays and family uncertainty

current_revision_application: Rev0008 admits aftermath and grief terms into quarantine only. No public advice, no grief diagnosis, no funeral/legal instructions, no child private material, and no unclaimed-body records.
Rev0009 opens the tradition axis only as quarantined vocabulary/source records.
No ritual steps, restricted knowledge, sacred interior, or community-representative voice may be public without explicit tradition-holder/community review.
Tukdam, Indigenous or restricted practices, child ritual material, suicide/custody/violent death rituals, and local-law body-care questions remain high-gate.
Rev0012 opens witness-role records but keeps child, survivor, worker-confession, official, custody, suicide, overdose, and unwitnessed-account material quarantined.

Rev0020 adds absence/official-trace records for no-witness, missing/unrecovered, unclaimed/unidentified, ME/coroner, database, certificate, notification, and negative-proof language. All are publication-blocked.
hard_rule: A high-gate record cannot be added merely because a public source exists. It needs domain review and a publication/no-publication decision before extraction.

rev0010_additions.rule: No trajectory record may produce countdowns, hospice eligibility, treatment advice, insurance logic, or cause-of-death determinations.

rev0011_additions.rule: No setting record may imply home, hospice, hospital, ICU, or care home is categorically better or worse.
No public rendering without domain-specific safe-messaging, legal, equity, and trauma review.
Humanitarian sources may provide dignity and identification vocabulary; no operational instructions or graphic publication.
No child, baby, sibling, parent, image, footprint, quote, or intimate family material enters public surfaces without explicit consent and specialist review.

rev0016_note: Added sensory high gates for child memory, smell, body weight, pets/nonprophecy, and machine-mediated deathbeds.

rev0016_additions.note: Added sensory high gates for child memory, smell, body weight, pets/nonprophecy, and machine-mediated deathbeds.

rev0018_note: Added high gate for living-family conflict, safeguarding risk, hidden relationships, and social-room identifiability.
rev0019_note: Pediatric/perinatal domain now has an atlas, publication block, developmental matrix, perinatal memory-making matrix, sibling-school gate, and high-gate coverage audit.
rev0021_note: Suicide/self-harm domain strengthened; overdose/substance-related death aftermath added as its own high-gate domain.
rev0022_note: Worker testimony and confession added as a high-gate domain; worker craft may be collected only with nonextraction protocols.

domains.reason: Workers hold oral death knowledge, but private worker wounds, patient details, employer details, and case material are not public property.

domains.rule: After-body, autopsy, donation, disposition, transport, and remains records are blocked from public rendering until funeral/regulatory, legal/jurisdictional, ethics, privacy, cultural/tradition, and publication-language review.
